name: compact-xray
description: See, line by line, what a Midnight Compact contract makes public — from the compiler itself.

compactXray.command.markdownDescription: Command that runs the X-Ray CLI; file arguments are appended. For a checkout: `/path/to/compact-xray/bin/compact-xray`. On Windows with the compiler in WSL: `wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash /mnt/c/path/to/compact-xray/bin/compact-xray` together with `compactXray.wslPaths`.

compactXray.wslPaths.description: Translate Windows paths (C:\…) to WSL paths (/mnt/c/…) when calling the command.

compactXray.runOnSave.description: Analyze .compact files when they are saved.

compactXray.showDisclosures.description: Show every disclosure as an information diagnostic on its line (advice is always shown).

compactXray.codeLens.description: Show what each circuit publishes above its declaration.
